text:
Alex Kim: Heads-up — ran AWQ calibration on Mixtral-8x7B last night on dedicated pool. Repro: seq=1024, batch=8, RoPE scale=1.2. Observed tail latency regression (P95) ~+45ms compared to fp16 baseline. Repro steps and profiles below.

Maria Chen: Oof. Did the runtime fall back to a different kernel after quant? which kernel was selected where?

Alex Kim: Yes — runtime picked flash_attn_v2 for most layers but fell back to generic_mha on ~3 layers after AWQ because weight layout checks failed post-quant. Perf excerpt (seq=1024):
```
Baseline (fp16, fused_mha): throughput=720 tok/s, P50=12ms, P95=68ms
AWQ (per-layer calib, mixtral): throughput=660 tok/s (-8.3%), P50=13ms, P95=113ms (+66%)
INT8-GPTQ attempt: throughput=690 tok/s, P95=95ms
```

Jordan Patel: Hmm, that magnitude suggests both kernel fallback and KV-cache churn. Do we have KV hit/miss stats?

Tiago Souza: I grabbed traces — after AWQ the KV tensors got block-padded to 32-byte alignment for the int8 layout, causing more pages and evictions. Cache miss rate went from 6.8% -> 19.1% under same workload. Traces show extra memcpy overhead during get_kv.

Maria Chen: Can you paste the kernel selection policy used? maybe we should prefer fused_mha for long sequences.

Alex Kim: Current policy snippet:
```yaml
kernel_policy: ["auto", "flash_attn_v2", "fused_mha", "generic_mha"]
seq_threshold: 512
quant_compat_check: true
force_fallback_on_layout_mismatch: true
```
We rely on quant_compat_check to avoid incorrect kernels, but the check is tripping on AWQ's per-channel scale+zero_point pattern for some layers.

Priya Rao: Also note RoPE scaling interactions — on Qwen we saw RoPE >1.1 change attention magnitude and it triggered a different code path that expects fp16-friendly weight distributions. Quantized kernels assumed symmetric distributions and failed the compatibility predicate.

Jordan Patel: Do we have accuracy deltas from calibration prompts? Might be worth checking if AWQ calibration skewed the distribution.

Alex Kim: Calibration set used: ["wmt14-en-de 128", "codegen/short-cases", "math-wordproblems 64", "squad-mini 64"]. Eval (held-out mix): EM/BLEU drop ~1.7% vs fp16 on heavy LlamaEval tasks; GPT-style CE increased slightly. So AWQ didn't catastrophically break accuracy but impacted distribution tails.

Tiago Souza: Important detail: AWQ stored per-tensor scales in float16 meta which some kernels read as float32 and do a small branch -> layout mismatch. That branch caused runtime to mark layer unsafe and use generic_mha.

Maria Chen: Proposed quick mitigations: 1) force fused_mha for Mixtral on dedicated hosts while we fix compat check. 2) rerun AWQ calibration using balanced prompts across heads (code/math/lang) and per-layer calibration. 3) try GPTQ INT8 per-channel varscale to check kernel compatibility.

Alex Kim: Agreed. Also adding: compact KV padding post-quant (pad compaction job) to reduce cache pages; add a runtime flag to allow relaxed compat check for layers passing parity checks.

perf-bot: regression-alert: job=mixtral-8x7B-AWQ-2026-03-16T09:12, metric=tail-latency P95, delta=+38ms, link=https://ci/reports/1769 :warning:

Jordan Patel: I'll run ablations tomorrow: toggle RoPE scale {1.0, 1.05, 1.1, 1.15} and measure per-head attention norm, plus re-run with AWQ cal prompts that include longer-range context. Will capture kernel selection map (layer->kernel) and KV mem layout pre/post quant.

Priya Rao: Also test INT8 path with fused_mha and flash_attn_v2 kernels enabled — INT8 sometimes preserves layout so no fallback. Try both per-channel rounding strategies.

Alex Kim: Action items for eng-runtime:
- Rerun AWQ calib with diversified prompts and per-layer calibrator (Alex/Tiago)
- Run GPTQ-INT8 ablation and measure kernel compat (Jordan)
- Add runtime flag to prefer fused_mha for Mixtral-longseq on dedicated pools (Maria)
- Implement KV pad compaction background job (Tiago)
- Update compat check to be tolerant to fp16 meta vs fp32 kernel readers (follow up)

Maria Chen: Also add a short eval harness for accuracy delta on our standard 3 eval sets when we flip quant strategy — want automatic gating.

Alex Kim: I'll file an issue and tag eng-runtime. For now revert Mixtral AWQ on prod dedicated if we see P95 > baseline + 20ms. :thumbsup:

Priya Rao: noted, assigning follow-ups in the issue.

Alex Kim: Thanks — will post the pipeline outputs and the kernel selection map when available.

Maria Chen: thanks, good plan. :white_check_mark:
